title: Rhythm Kings session aftermath, later jobs, steamers, Catskills, parades and opinions
summary: He discusses the Rappolo dispute after the Rhythm Kings record, later spot jobs, shipyard work in the war, steamboat and Catskills engagements, marching bands, and his favorite players.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
